scope: Original surface finish on existing route-visible named forms. No geometry, placement, collision, vegetation or artwork reconstruction.
source_contract: Existing M1 2022 City survey geometry and separately dated identity references. Existing estimates remain estimates. Surface grain, weathering and roughness are original visual interpretations, not measured material samples.
licence: New texture and shader artwork is original procedural work. Existing City survey attribution remains Open Government Licence - Vancouver. Existing OSM attribution remains ODbL-1.0 where listed by the source. No source photos, carved patterns or inscriptions are included.
unresolved_limits: The Siwash vegetation envelope is excluded from this surface pass; the tree layer owns vegetation.
Sculptures and totem forms retain coarse profiles. This pass does not reproduce an artist's detailed work.
The missing southwest People Amongst the People portal remains a source-limited inland feature. Its location is not invented.
Building windows, doors and individual masonry joints are not invented from generic patterns.
Route visibility, landmark recognition and material appearance require the authorized visual review; distance screening is not a sightline proof.
